_comment: One tree per combat style. A tree earns a point at every fifth level of its skill; each node costs one, needs its milestone level in that skill, and needs the node above it in its branch. A node with a 'technique' teaches a move that replaces the charged heavy attack with that style's weapon once it is chosen as the active technique. Effects are fractions unless noted: damage 0.06 is +6%.

nodes.name: Keen Edge
nodes.desc: Melee attacks deal 6% more damage.

nodes.name: Flurry
nodes.desc: Melee attacks are 8% faster.

nodes.name: Whirlwind
nodes.desc: Technique. A charged heavy attack spins, striking everything around you.

nodes.name: Executioner
nodes.desc: Melee attacks have an 8% chance to critically strike for half again the damage.

nodes.name: Bloodlust
nodes.desc: Melee damage you deal heals you for 6% of it.

nodes.name: Heavy Hand
nodes.desc: Charged attacks wind up 15% faster, whatever you are holding.

nodes.name: Bruiser
nodes.desc: Melee attacks knock back 30% harder and deal 4% more damage.

nodes.name: Ground Slam
nodes.desc: Technique. A charged heavy attack slams the ground, hitting and throwing back everything nearby.

nodes.name: Brute Force
nodes.desc: Melee attacks deal 10% more damage.

nodes.name: Titan
nodes.desc: Charged melee attacks and techniques deal 20% more damage.

nodes.name: Thick Skin
nodes.desc: +6 Defence bonus, with any weapon.

nodes.name: Second Wind
nodes.desc: Stamina refills 25% faster.

nodes.name: Lunge
nodes.desc: Technique. A charged heavy attack dashes forward, striking everything in the way.

nodes.name: Iron Will
nodes.desc: +12 Defence bonus, with any weapon.

nodes.name: Last Stand
nodes.desc: Below a third of your health, melee attacks deal 25% more damage.

nodes.name: Steady Aim
nodes.desc: Arrows deal 6% more damage.

nodes.name: Eagle Eye
nodes.desc: Arrows fly 15% faster and have a 4% chance to critically strike.

nodes.name: Piercing Shot
nodes.desc: Technique. A charged shot looses one heavy arrow that flies fast and passes through everything in its path.

nodes.name: Deadly Aim
nodes.desc: Arrows have another 8% chance to critically strike.

nodes.name: Deadeye
nodes.desc: Critical arrows deal double damage instead of half again.

nodes.name: Quick Draw
nodes.desc: You draw and loose 8% faster.

nodes.name: Fleet Foot
nodes.desc: You move 6% faster, with any weapon.

nodes.name: Volley
nodes.desc: Technique. A charged shot looses a fan of five arrows.

nodes.name: Rapid Fire
nodes.desc: You draw and loose another 10% faster.

nodes.name: Hail
nodes.desc: Every arrow passes through one more enemy.

nodes.name: Trail Legs
nodes.desc: 15% more stamina, with any weapon.

nodes.name: Broadheads
nodes.desc: Arrows knock back 30% harder and deal 4% more damage.

nodes.name: Arrow Rain
nodes.desc: Technique. A charged shot calls a storm of arrows down on your target a moment later.

nodes.name: Predator
nodes.desc: Arrows deal 10% more damage.

nodes.name: Bloodletting
nodes.desc: Arrow damage you deal heals you for 5% of it.

nodes.name: Potency
nodes.desc: Spells deal 6% more damage.

nodes.name: Focus
nodes.desc: Spells cost 10% less mana.

nodes.name: Nova
nodes.desc: Technique. A charged cast bursts outward in a ring of eight bolts of your element, for twice the mana.

nodes.name: Amplify
nodes.desc: Spells deal 10% more damage.

nodes.name: Archmage
nodes.desc: Spells cost another 25% less mana and deal 10% more damage.

nodes.name: Flow
nodes.desc: Mana refills 20% faster.

nodes.name: Swift Casting
nodes.desc: You cast 8% faster.

nodes.name: Barrage
nodes.desc: Technique. A charged cast looses four seeking bolts of your element at once, for twice the mana.

nodes.name: Wellspring
nodes.desc: Mana refills another 30% faster.

nodes.name: Overflow
nodes.desc: Spells have a 10% chance to critically strike.

nodes.name: Ward
nodes.desc: +6 Defence bonus, with any weapon.

nodes.name: Seeker
nodes.desc: Every spell steers after its target, even water and earth.

nodes.name: Meteor
nodes.desc: Technique. A charged cast brings your element crashing down on your target a moment later, for three times the mana.

nodes.name: Siphon
nodes.desc: Spell damage you deal heals you for 4% of it.

nodes.name: Elemental Mastery
nodes.desc: Spells that are strong against a creature's element deal another 20% more damage.
